title: Add per-turn model/tool timing diagnostics
description:
Problem
PR #243 added aggregate model usage tracking, but the report only shows whole model-call durations by purpose/model. In session-mqkis411-rlsh20, total wall-clock time was higher than expected. The aggregate usage report showed:

- gameplay_turn: 3 calls, 132.5s, 1 failed
- turn_audit: 2 calls, 34.9s

This proves audit was not the dominant cost, but it does not explain how much gameplay_turn time was:
- model thinking
- Claude Agent SDK / harness overhead
- MCP tool execution
- retry wait time
- provider/session-limit failure delay
- orchestration overhead

Goal
Add per-turn timing diagnostics that make a slow turn explainable without exposing prompt or response content.

Scope
Instrument the model/tool execution path to produce a structural timing timeline for each player turn. The timeline should be safe to include in non-sensitive debug logs and/or usage diagnostics.

Capture at least:
- player turn id / session id / campaign id when available
- turn attempt number
- model-call purpose: gameplay_turn, turn_audit, retry, session_recap, arc_rollup, etc.
- model name and adapter capability metadata when available
- model call start/end/duration
- audit start/end/duration
- retry start/end/duration
- provider failure timing
- MCP/native tool call start/end/duration
- tool name
- tool source/transport, such as native-mcp/api-native/local
- whether each tool call was read-only, mutating, staged, committed, or rolled back when that metadata exists
- final turn outcome: accepted, rejected_then_retried, failed_before_apply, failed_after_reject, provider_limit, provider_error, audit_error, etc.

Acceptance Criteria
- A slow turn can be decomposed into model time, audit time, retry time, and tool time using debug/usage output.
- MCP tool calls executed inside the Agent SDK loop are timed individually as much as the current adapter architecture allows.
- Retry attempts are distinguishable from initial gameplay_turn attempts.
- Provider/session-limit failures record elapsed time before failure.
- The diagnostics do not write prompt text, response text, or campaign-private prose into the usage DB.
- Add tests for:
  1. successful turn with primary model + audit produces separate timing spans
  2. rejected candidate + retry produces distinct attempt spans
  3. provider-limit failure records failed attempt duration and reason category
  4. MCP tool calls are included with per-tool duration and tool name
- Existing eshyra usage output either includes a concise timing breakdown or gains a flag such as --timeline / --details for detailed per-turn timing.
- Best-effort diagnostics must not prevent gameplay startup or turn execution if timing persistence fails.

Non-goals
- Do not estimate token counts when the provider does not expose them.
- Do not record prompt/response bodies.
- Do not require an additional model call just to classify timing.
- Do not solve transactional tool rollback here, except to display staged/committed/rolled-back metadata if available from that work.

Implementation Notes
The desired output should make questions like these answerable:
- Was this slow because the primary model thought for 45 seconds?
- Was it slow because the auditor ran repeatedly?
- Was it slow because MCP tools were executed one at a time through the Agent SDK harness?
- Did a retry spend 50 seconds before returning a session-limit error?
- How much elapsed time did tool execution add compared to model/audit time?

Example conceptual timeline:
turn session-mqkis411-rlsh20 / input #2
  attempt 1 gameplay_turn claude-opus-4-8: 38.4s rejected
    tool lookup_rules: 1.2s read-only
    tool give_item: 0.8s mutating staged
    tool give_item: 0.7s mutating staged
  audit claude-haiku-4-5: 18.3s reject
  attempt 2 retry claude-opus-4-8: 52.3s failed provider_limit
  outcome failed_before_apply
notes: Implemented on branch eshyra-17ng-turn-timing-diagnostics; PR #247 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/247) open for review. Adds tool/model/outcome timing spans + 'eshyra usage --timeline'. Awaiting review/merge.
close_reason: Merged via PR #247 (squash). Per-turn model/tool timing diagnostics + 'eshyra usage --timeline'.
